proposed_from.topic: Robust joint-intervention design on locally switched causal stars. Fix binary observed variables with arrows w→T for every proxy w and T→Y, and let independent two-mode local switches choose bidirected edges, with equality/complement copies only. Before switch modes are revealed, choose one unit-cost proxy set J and acquire the complete single joint source P(V\J | do(J=j)) for every j, plus P(V). Prove P_t(Y) is identifiable on a completion iff T and Y are disconnected after deleting J; give the explicit adjustment functional and strictly positive binary same-source countermodels when a path survives. Prove deciding whether some |J|≤B works for every completion is Σ₂ᴾ-complete using occurrence-copy pairs, budget-saturating pair tests, consistency paths, and selector-isolated clause chains, with singleton T,Y, constant-size switches, and nonterminal bidirected degree at most eight; return J and per-completion gID certificates or, for a fixed failing J, a completion and hedge. Compare explicitly with Akbari et al. 2023/2025, Elahi et al. 2024, Jaber et al. 2022, and switched robust-cut literature. The consumer is a dosearch pre-data design mode for one multiplex intervention under local graph uncertainty. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: The presolve derived the exact causal-star disconnect criterion, adjustment formula, and full-support binary indistinguishability construction. It built a quantified reduction whose rounding argument prevents auxiliary interventions and whose selector chains prevent inactive-module bypasses. Exact checks matched hedge and path criteria in 8,192 graph/intervention cases, exhausted all budget-feasible cuts in four compiled quantified examples, and verified dyadic countermodel tables for one-to-four internal proxies. Greatest-completion families collapse to ordinary cut; bounded possible terminal neighborhoods and PAG scope are excluded, and terminal degrees remain unbounded. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Independently audit the uniform occurrence/equality/selector compiler and resolve priority against switched-cut and forbidden-pair-path literature; do not broaden from the proved causal-star criterion to unrestricted strictly-binary gID without a separate semantic completeness proof. EARLY KILL TEST: Regenerate every two-clause formula over one existential and one universal variable, exhaust all auxiliary-inclusive budget cuts and switch assignments, and stop if quantified truth ever differs from residual T–Y disconnection. seed_details.seed: Quantified robust joint-proxy design on locally switched causal stars
seed_details.anchor_location: Theorem 1.3 and Section 4, especially the reduction outline and inconsistency gadgets; Introduction and Conclusion were also read.
seed_details.opportunity: Prove that choosing one proxy intervention set before all equality or complement switch modes are revealed is \(\Sigma_2^{\mathrm P}\)-complete, even though each revealed causal-star instance reduces to ordinary reachability.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace selection of forbidden arc pairs by deletion of unit-cost causal proxy vertices, then make every auxiliary vertex harmless through budget-saturating pair tests and selector-isolated chains.
seed_details.target_method_search: Searches for robust causal intervention design under graph uncertainty, locally switched vertex cuts, correlated-failure interdiction, and forbidden-pair path separation found no theorem with this causal protocol and restriction package.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Bachtler, Bergner, and Krumke because both problems have an existential design followed by a universal path obstruction.
seed_details.rebuttal: Their selected objects are forbidden arc pairs in one fixed directed graph; the causal result needs a uniform occurrence compiler, unit-cost vertex deletions including auxiliaries, correlated local edge modes, and an exact gID-to-connectivity semantic bridge.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The kernel names a decision language, an explicit compiler, a complexity class, a causal source protocol, and structural restrictions; it is not an application-only seed.
seed_details.burned_reason: The selected robust causal-star angle was exhausted at D0.5: exact released-graph metadata, unrestricted switch-copy fanout and terminal degree, absent implementation/application evidence, and cursory closest-work comparison cap it below field; lifting the floor requires D-1.2 re-anchoring.

seed_details.seed: Exact positive-binary source criterion for a fixed causal-star completion
seed_details.anchor_location: Theorem 1, Algorithm 2, Section 5's positive-model construction, and the Introduction and Conclusion.
seed_details.opportunity: Characterize identification from one complete joint proxy source by the exact condition that \(T\) and \(Y\) are disconnected after deleting the intervened proxies, with an adjustment functional and full-support binary countermodels for every surviving path.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Specialize Kivva et al.'s source-by-source district test to the star, then replace its general finite-domain nonidentification construction by an explicit binary Markov-chain product witness.
seed_details.target_method_search: Searches pairing strictly binary gID, causal stars, joint proxy interventions, and residual connectivity located fixed-graph gID criteria but not the stated binary iff theorem or path-indexed same-source witness.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Kivva et al. because their Theorem 1 already reduces positive gID to ordinary identification in a supplied source graph.
seed_details.rebuttal: The sufficiency is a specialization, but the exact residual-path criterion, completion-invariant adjustment form, and strictly positive binary countermodels simultaneously matching all multiplex cells are not stated there.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: Necessity is uniform over every surviving path length and uses a full-support family rather than one hand-tuned law.
seed_details.disposition: survived as the semantic foundation of the selected seed

seed_details.seed: Two-sided switch-aware certification without completion enumeration
seed_details.anchor_location: Theorem 1 on thickets, Algorithm 1, Theorems 2 and 3, and the Introduction and Conclusion.
seed_details.opportunity: Return a robust design and a completion-indexed positive certificate interface, or for a fixed failed design return one switch assignment and a path-induced hedge.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Compress Lee, Correa, and Bareinboim's recursive fixed-graph formula or thicket output to the star-specific pair consisting of an outcome district and a residual path.
seed_details.target_method_search: Searches for symbolic certificates over switched graph families and dosearch planning found fixed-graph gID and PAG algorithms, but no certificate language that preserves equality or complement correlations among optional edges.
seed_details.red_team: A breadth-first search and a hedge are routine once a completion is supplied.
seed_details.rebuttal: The local checker is deliberately simple; the contribution is the exact two-sided interface coupled to a succinct robust design problem whose positive output does not enumerate completions.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The certificate theorem is retained as a consumer-facing consequence, not advertised as a new general gID algorithm.

seed_details.anchor_location: Appendix D on tree-like tractable cases, Lemma 13, the Introduction, and the closing discussion of structural restrictions.
seed_details.opportunity: Determine whether bounding the possible bidirected neighborhoods of both terminals collapses robust star design to a lower complexity class or whether a degree-reduced \(\Sigma_2^{\mathrm P}\)-hardness construction exists.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the terminal hubs in the quantified compiler by bounded-degree splitter interfaces without creating affordable auxiliary cuts.
seed_details.target_method_search: Searches combining bounded terminal incidence with forbidden-pair separation or switched robust cuts found acyclic hardness and fixed-graph structural algorithms, but no matching terminal-degree theorem.
seed_details.red_team: Bounded terminal degree makes the candidate intervention neighborhood constant and therefore the question is already in coNP.
seed_details.rebuttal: That argument applies when the union of all possible terminal neighbors is bounded; bounding every completion's terminal degree can still leave an unbounded switched union and is a distinct unresolved regime.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: Kept only as an explicit open-ended question because the current compiler has unbounded terminal degree.

seed_details.seed: QBF compilation with intervention-safe auxiliary vertices
seed_details.anchor_location: Theorem 1, its Appendix C proof, the Boolean hedge-hull iterations, and the Introduction and Conclusion.
seed_details.opportunity: Construct a solver-ready quantified Boolean encoding whose satisfying outer assignment is exactly a unit-cost proxy design and whose universal assignment selects a completion.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Add universal switch variables and selector isolation to Elahi et al.'s fixed-graph Boolean reachability encoding, then prove a rounding lemma that removes interventions on encoding auxiliaries.
seed_details.target_method_search: Queries for QBF encodings of uncertain-graph causal experiment design returned SAT and ILP encodings for one known graph, not a sound and complete quantified encoding with extractable causal witnesses.
seed_details.red_team: This is a routine replacement of SAT by QBF.
seed_details.rebuttal: A naive replacement permits cuts on clause junctions and cross-module bypasses; the budget saturation, occurrence consistency, and full-edge selector gating are the non-routine correctness content.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: Not selected alone because an encoding without the causal iff theorem would be an engineering contribution.
seed_details.disposition: merged into the selected compiler theorem

seed_details.seed: Fixed-design robustness and its coNP boundary
seed_details.anchor_location: Section 4 membership argument for separating by forbidden pairs and the QSAT reduction outline.
seed_details.opportunity: Show that deciding whether a supplied \(J\) works for every switch completion is coNP-complete already at zero intervention budget, with a completion and residual path as a short negative witness.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Delete the existential design layer from the quantified path construction and encode a 3CNF solely through universal edge modes.
seed_details.target_method_search: No fixed-design coNP classification was found for causal proxy acquisition over correlated local-switch ADMG families.
seed_details.red_team: The claim is the universal half of the main reduction and adds no independent mathematics.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds as a standalone paper, so the claim is retained only as a boundary corollary rather than a seed-level contribution.

seed_details.anchor_location: Theorem 4, Sections 5 and 6, and the Introduction's formulation of PAG identification without enumeration.
seed_details.opportunity: Develop a complete calculus over equality or complement switched ADMG families whose correlated completions cannot be represented by a PAG.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace PAG-local orientation invariants in CIDP by Boolean guards carried through every graphical rule.
seed_details.target_method_search: The destination search found PAG completeness and fixed-graph gID but not a complete calculus for arbitrary correlated switch circuits.
seed_details.red_team: A switch circuit is merely a verbose representation of a finite list of ADMGs, so enumeration is already complete.
seed_details.rebuttal: Succinctness makes enumeration exponential, but a polynomial complete calculus is not supported by the current star-only semantic proof.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: Rejected because it would improperly broaden the proved causal-star criterion to unrestricted gID.

seed_details.seed: One formula valid before completion revelation
seed_details.anchor_location: Lemma 3 on downward validity, Problems 1 and 2, Appendix C on perfect correlations, and the Introduction's most-plausible-formula discussion.
seed_details.opportunity: Characterize when the same identifying expression, rather than a completion-specific expression, is valid across all local-switch completions.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Intersect formula-validity regions across correlated completions instead of maximizing their probability mass.
seed_details.target_method_search: The located uncertain-network work optimizes plausibility and the PAG work seeks equivalence-class validity, but neither handles an arbitrary equality or complement switch circuit with the proposed source protocol.
seed_details.red_team: The star formula already depends on the completion through the outcome district, so the seed changes the protocol and may be false without exponentially large expressions.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection is unresolved and the brief permits revelation before formula construction, so this is not the present kernel.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: Dropped rather than silently strengthening uniform identification into common-formula identification.

seed_details.anchor_location: Theorem 4, hedge-hull reduction, Appendix D tractable cases, and the Introduction.
seed_details.opportunity: Characterize switch families whose completions admit a greatest bidirected graph and extend ordinary cut algorithms to families of bounded switch-interface width.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace one fixed hedge hull by a dynamic program over boundary connectivity states of the switch circuit.
seed_details.target_method_search: Searches for local-switch interface-width algorithms found ordinary dynamic connectivity and robust-flow work but no causal gID design theorem for this family.
seed_details.red_team: A greatest completion makes the answer an immediate minimum cut.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds for the greatest-completion half; only the interface-width extension could be new, and it lacks enough direct evidence for the present version.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: Retained only as a sanity reduction and future algorithmic frontier.
